# At Fort Bragg, a jam session for a “new era of warfare”


[Colin Demarest](https://www.axios.com/authors/colin.demarest@axios.com)


*FORT BRAGG, North Carolina —* The scrubby, scorching-hot hills of Range 63 bustled last week with soldiers and contractors. Some nursed cans of Monster. Some rocked sunglasses and sun shirts. Some handled shotgun magazines.
